race.comment: ALABAMA LIONESS (4) finished fourth last start over 1720m at Young, beaten 4 metres, after a good win at Young the run prior. Big chance if anywhere near her best. LESSISMORE (2) finished third last start over 1720m at Young, beaten 3 metres. Best recent result was a win at this track three starts ago. Has the benefit of a good draw. Good enough to win a race of this calibre. THE GREAT WAVE (3) is better than her first-up tenth over 1720m at Young a week-and-a-half ago. Each-way claims. ALWAYS BE BRENDAN (7) is in the mix following a sixth at his first run back over 1720m at Young.
